provenance.method: Independent source/README/skill-derived oracles; synthetic fixtures; no prior evaluation reports

confirmedFindings.title: Literal user operation-prefix text is excluded from drop and history recovery
confirmedFindings.expected: Retain and find the synthetic user message beginning with the operation prefix.
confirmedFindings.actual: The message is missing; the first projected message is raw tool output. Real SDK user events reproduce both exclusions.
confirmedFindings.impact: A user's requirements or quoted example can disappear from active context and cannot be recovered through context_history, although original journal events remain.
confirmedFindings.improvement: Identify generated control events using provenance and exact operation/message identity, not a textual prefix shared with arbitrary user prose. Reuse that predicate in retention and recovery.

confirmedFindings.title: History recovery has narrower readable-field coverage than retention
confirmedFindings.repro: node --test --test-name-pattern='Readable text available only|Distinct model-transformed' evals/context-prune/independent.test.mjs
confirmedFindings.expected: Queries recover readable block-only rationale and a distinct transformed user constraint after compact.
confirmedFindings.actual: Both queries return zero matches. Blocks are ignored and nonempty content suppresses transformedContent.
confirmedFindings.impact: Compaction can omit facts that the documented recovery path cannot then discover.
confirmedFindings.improvement: Index all readable narrative fields using shared field extraction, preserving distinct displayed/transformed text and readable blocks without including opaque provider state.

confirmedFindings.title: Global readable-block deduplication loses in-source multiplicity
confirmedFindings.expected: Synthetic thinking blocks [first, second, first] remain in that order.
confirmedFindings.impact: The exact ordered readable-text guarantee fails for a valid repeated-block representation. Live provider prevalence is unmeasured.
confirmedFindings.improvement: Deduplicate mirrored representations, not repeated occurrences within a representation; retain source ordering and multiplicity.

confirmedFindings.title: Recovery records omit the structured success flag
confirmedFindings.expected: Recovered failed tool evidence carries success=false.
confirmedFindings.actual: Recovered records contain content but no success field; the real SDK failure probe reproduces this.
confirmedFindings.impact: A result without separate error text cannot be reliably distinguished from success from the recovery record alone. Current docs do not promise a particular record schema.
confirmedFindings.improvement: Include success and structured error metadata for tool result matches in both call-ID and query recovery.

risks.finding: A null entry in a reasoning block summary throws TypeError before preparation. SDK declares generic JSON blocks, but this provider shape was not observed live.
risks.improvement: Validate arrays and nested object types before reading text; preserve neighboring valid readable entries and fail explicitly on unrecoverable evidence.

risks.repro: node --test --test-name-pattern='Recovering a failed tool retains' evals/context-prune/independent.test.mjs
risks.finding: The accepted legacy string-result branch returns before appending error metadata. Current SDK event schema uses object results, and the live failed result was not a string.
risks.improvement: Either preserve diagnostics in the legacy branch or explicitly narrow supported historical event formats; do not count this as a demonstrated current-SDK failure.

risks.finding: Final queue/history checks and clear are separate awaited RPCs. Mocked checks catch interleavings during checkpoint readback, but cannot establish atomicity after the final snapshot.
risks.improvement: Document the SDK's clear-time concurrency guarantee or use a generation-checked clear if supported. Do not claim an observed lost-input race.

unsupportedOrOverstrongOracles.finding: Byte-identical replacement serialization was stronger than the public contract. Parsed JSON finding keys reorder on replay; semantic field values are unchanged.
unsupportedOrOverstrongOracles.disposition: Failing assertions retained. Not a product defect and not a recommended priority. Test 26 executes all semantic round/delimiter cases.

unsupportedOrOverstrongOracles.finding: The SDK did not record the thrown diagnostic marker despite confirmed handler execution. context_history preserves the SDK's actual error exactly.
unsupportedOrOverstrongOracles.disposition: Failing assertion retained as an upstream diagnostic limitation; the extension cannot recover data absent from the recorded event.

deliberateLimitations: A clear installs one text string, not native roles or restored private reasoning.
Same-session process exit/resume remains mandatory for the supported TUI contract; this SDK-only run does not prove the restriction unnecessary.
Binary attachments are refused in drop mode, and missing native spill artifacts cannot be recreated.
Agent-authored findings and compact summaries cannot be proven faithful by section/schema validation alone.
niceToHaves: Add a preflight view reporting mode, tool count, replacement size estimate, and reload requirement without changing context.
Version and document a recovery-record schema including searchable fields and error/status semantics.
Use measured context attribution to warn when replacement overhead exceeds removed tool text; avoid arbitrary token quotas.
Publish these reproducible synthetic/live probes instead of relying on unverifiable descriptions of private evaluation sessions.
integrationGaps: Live readable-block provider emission and reasoning fidelity
TUI extension discovery and stale live-context behavior
Live custom compact summary quality and real mixed-mode execution
Binary evidence and expired spill-file recovery
Crash between durable checkpoint save and clear
